answer: Proof of genuine economic liveness: each identity must keep a garden of co-signed transactions with diverse, independent counterparties — real invoices, delivered work, paid fees — recorded in the public receipt vault. Graph analysis detects wash rings by circular flows and shared counterparties, flagging farms. A lone juniper of honest trade keeps its own distinct rings; a sybil nursery shows identical ones. The attacker must manufacture N distinct sets of real business relationships, paying real costs per puppet; honest agents simply do business once. Caught wash rings burn their bonds.
